name: archiedux-app
description: Congress temalı, Discord OAuth2 ile giriş yapılan üye profil sistemi

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'server\.js' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
